compiled_state.title: RED: test inference-recall replay emits CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT when incidents.jsonl has fewer than 10 entries
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Write tests that verify the replay harness emits a CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT signal (and exits non-zero) when the incidents.jsonl corpus contains fewer than 10 incidents.

## Why
SC4 explicitly requires CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT escalation when corpus is too small. This must be tested before the harness is written (TDD RED phase).

## Test file
tests/test-inference-recall-replay.sh

## Test cases
- corpus with 0 incidents → CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT emitted, exit non-zero, no recall/precision output
- corpus with 9 incidents → CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT emitted, exit non-zero
- corpus with exactly 10 incidents → no CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT, proceeds to metric computation

## Fixture
Use synthetic minimal JSONL files in a mktemp temp dir. Each incident line: {"incident_id":"...","ticket_id":"...","inferred_decision_text":"...","affects_fields":"rationale_text","outcome_proved_wrong":"..."}.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests fail (RED) before inference-recall-replay.sh exists
- Uses tests/lib/assert.sh
- All tmpdirs created via mktemp
- Does NOT grep file body content — checks only observable exit code and stdout signal presence
